query: start working on the auth-broker timeout bug in agentihooks-bundle
expected_behavior: resolves WT via the SKILL.md's own symlink before calling it
runs "$WT" new with a short kebab-case task name as the first act, before any edit
treats the cycle as done only once $DEST exists and git -C "$DEST" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD prints that name

query: wt new refused: below 50 GB free
expected_behavior: answers by finishing existing worktrees with done and running agentihooks gc
does not raise WT_MIN_FREE_GB or WT_MAX_PER_REPO to get past the refusal

query: I just need to check something against a clean base tree, nothing to keep
expected_behavior: creates a tmp worktree with "$WT" tmp rather than a plain git worktree add
removes it with "$WT" done once the check is finished, even if the checkout is dirty

query: the PR for this worktree's branch just merged into dev, clean up
expected_behavior: runs "$WT" done <name> in the same turn as the merge
reports the blocker by name instead of forcing when the primary checkout is not on a clean dev
